assumptions.statement: The locked repository SITE-001 polygon is used only as a provisional generation and review extent.
assumptions.impact: Every spatial value and derived visual is repeatable against current geometry but has no statutory precision.
assumptions.resolution: Replace it with the official polygon and regenerate geometry, metrics, figures, HTML, and PDFs as one dependency chain.

assumptions.statement: All three key areas are provisional task indexes; PROV-KEY-003 carries a public displacement warning.
assumptions.impact: Study windows and testbed anchors cannot be treated as official site-specific conclusions.
assumptions.resolution: Replace all three polygons and rerun the key-area siting and area calculations.

assumptions.statement: No site visit, facility inventory, accompanied walk, or accessibility audit was completed in this iteration.
assumptions.impact: Continuity, entrances, opening status, facilities, and user burdens remain hypotheses.
assumptions.resolution: Complete a georeferenced field base and three user journeys before any V0.5 site prototype.

assumptions.statement: No resident, worker, campus, enterprise, operator, railway, or public-agency interview was completed.
assumptions.impact: Personas are exclusion lenses rather than representative voices; no partnership is implied.
assumptions.resolution: Run problem-owner, operator, accessibility, and affected-user interviews and record dissent as design evidence.

assumptions.statement: FAR, height, density, setbacks, redlines, service standards, and detailed regulatory controls are unavailable.
assumptions.impact: Development intensity remains unknown and no regulatory recommendation is asserted.
assumptions.resolution: Confirm through statutory planning material and professional planning review.

assumptions.statement: Existing-building use, ownership, structure, fire, building services, and heritage evidence are incomplete.
assumptions.impact: Conceptual footprints cannot identify real buildings or support demolition, retention, or adaptation decisions.
assumptions.resolution: Complete a building audit before assigning retain, renovate, or demolish status.

assumptions.statement: Rail protection, utility, drainage, flood, energy, network, and public-service baselines are unavailable at project level.
assumptions.impact: Interfaces show questions and dependencies, not capacity, access permission, or engineering feasibility.
assumptions.resolution: Coordinate railway, transport, municipal, water, energy, fire, and cybersecurity studies.

assumptions.statement: No named institution has committed to operate a testbed, human desk, archive, route, or annual review.
assumptions.impact: All projects and events remain conceptual and cannot enter V1.0 without accountable people.
assumptions.resolution: Identify authorised operators, duty rosters, insurance, complaint channels, and an ultimate accountable person.

assumptions.statement: Five global innovation cases and general public-space guidance inform mechanisms only.
assumptions.impact: No external scale, institutional arrangement, or claimed performance is transferred to Jing-Zhang.
assumptions.resolution: Test each mechanism against local evidence, governance, and operating cost.

assumptions.statement: Known spatial metrics are calculated in EPSG:4548 from package geometry; counts come from versioned JSON assets.
assumptions.impact: Metrics are internally auditable but change with official geometry or design edits.
assumptions.resolution: Regenerate metrics and every display output after each material spatial change.
